faq.title: Common Plumbing Questions
faq.description: Answer typical customer concerns to build trust and reduce booking friction.

items.question: Do you offer emergency plumbing service?
items.answer: Yes. We provide emergency response for urgent issues like burst pipes, severe leaks, and major clogs.

items.question: Do you provide upfront pricing?
items.answer: Yes. We diagnose the issue first and provide a clear quote before we start work.

items.question: What plumbing services do you handle?
items.answer: We handle drain cleaning, leak repair, water heater service, fixture installs, repiping, and more.

items.question: Are your plumbers licensed and insured?
items.answer: Yes. Our technicians are trained, licensed where required, and fully insured.
